verdict.rationale: LlamaParse documents a single parse API that covers 130+ file formats. The docs explicitly name PDFs, scans, Office files, images and Excel/spreadsheets, all handled through the same `client.parsing.parse` call. HTML and email are never named, DOCX/PPTX are only implied by the umbrella term "Office files," and no independent hands-on evidence confirms mixed-format handling, so coverage of the full mix is unproven. missing for 10: explicit documentation of HTML and email (.eml/.msg) support, explicit naming of DOCX/PPTX, independent corroboration of mixed-format parsing without per-format configuration.

support.subject: As a developer, one API handles my whole document mix — PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, images, email — without per-format plumbing

citations.quote: LlamaParse supports 130+ file formats across four categories.
Parse converts PDFs, scans and Office files to markdown or JSON
Turn PDFs, scans, or images into clean LLM-ready text
Parse Excel files and build a RAG app to answer questions about spreadsheet dat
it reads tables, charts, scanned pages, and 130+ file types with layout-aware accuracy
